summary: Agility Robotics (formerly Churchill Capital Corp XI, a Cayman SPAC) filed an 8-K reporting the November 4, 2026 closing of its de-SPAC business combination with privately held Agility Robotics, under a June 24, 2026 Agreement and Plan of Merger with BLB Merger Sub, Inc. The registrant rebranded to Agility Robotics, Inc., redomiciled into Delaware, and listed common stock and warrants on Nasdaq under AGLT and AGLTW. The excerpt does not state price per share or redemption figures; mechanics include multiple equity-issuance items (3.02, 4.01), control changes (5.01), officer appointments, and shell-company status termination (5.06). Watch post-closing redemptions, sponsor economics, lock-up overhang, and warrant dilution.
